The Pre-Master’s Program is designed to prepare international students for postgraduate study in the UK. The program will allow students to improve their English while learning the study skills and research methods that they will need during their Master’s degree studies.

The Master of Business Administration program at Aston University aims to cultivate strategic leaders. Through our dynamic curriculum, experiential learning, global perspectives and outstanding student experience, we equip our students for success in diverse business environments.
